status: PARTIAL. First data-driven table for the vanilla part of the pre-1.8 metadata layer (decision 25, option B). It is a design seed, not a finished decode table. v0.1.1 (pass 21) added the kinds cocoa, end_portal_frame, vine, powered_and_detector_rail and huge_mushroom and the mode and power bits of the comparator.

confidence_levels.corroborated: at least two independent sources agree on the field, and at least one is code from the 1.6 to 1.7 era (Forge 1.7.10 source, or the Bukkit API snapshot listed in sources)
confidence_levels.single_source: one source only (often the 1.12.2 wiki). Usable only for versions where the block existed, and VESSEL logs a yellow warning when it uses such a field
confidence_levels.convention_unresolved: the structure (mask and number of values) is corroborated, but the compass names differ between sources. VESSEL treats the field as opaque for conversion until resolved
confidence_levels.conflict: sources disagree on the content. Opaque
confidence_levels.unknown: no source read. Opaque, same rule as mod blocks

rule_for_third_party_decompiled_caches: Option C is reference only. A value that came from such a cache is used only if an independent source (Forge source, the Bukkit API, the wiki, or Shiroz's own decompile) proves it. Otherwise it is recorded as unverified and never used by VESSEL at runtime. No value in this file came from such a cache.

known_source_problems: The Bukkit snapshot has head f210234e59 with author date 2013-07-07 but commit date 2014-08-17, and a pom version of 1.7.10. [Examined in v0.1.1 and corrected in v0.1.2, 2026-10-03: its Material enum contains DOUBLE_PLANT, LOG_2, STAINED_GLASS and PACKED_ICE. In the Forge sources, double plant, log2 and stained glass appear in the heads of the mc172 and 1.7.10 branches but not in the 1.6.4 head (v164-pregradle). SLIME_BLOCK and BANNER exist neither in this Material enum nor in the Forge 1.7.10 tree. So the snapshot is not older than the 1.7.2 era; that it is exactly 1.7.10 is not shown. Why the author date is older than the commit date (a rebase or a cherry-pick) was not checked.]
Some Bukkit classes report the attached face while Forge reports facing; where both are semantically the same the entry says so.
The ForgeDirection ordinal order (down, up, north, south, west, east) was not read in Forge; the chest, dispenser and piston rows agree with Bukkit under that assumption, which supports it.

Forge before 1.6.4 has no usable table: branch 1.6 (2013-07-01) only rotates chests, pistons, droppers and dispensers; the 1.6.4 (v164-pregradle), 1.7.2 and 1.7.10 tables are identical. Nothing for 1.4 and 1.5 was read.

The wiki Pre-flattening page is still cut off after the torches section when fetched; for the six kinds of v0.1.1 only the mushroom data values could be read (through mirrors). Cocoa, end portal frame, vine, comparator and rails have no wiki row in this version.
